study type: Program evaluation (quasi-experimental) using retrospective cohort data from a national registry
exposure: National Perinatal Patient Safety Program in Sweden
Local improvement measures taken in perinatal risk areas
outcome: Number of settled patient injury claims due to asphyxia/substandard care
cohort: The study cohort consisted of all term newborns born in Sweden between 2006 and 2012.
finding: The national incidence of low Apgar score remained unchanged, but a significant decline in settled patient injury claims due to substandard care for severely asphyxiated neonates was observed.
